newsitem.title: USA: Democrats seek vote on Gingrich report.
newsitem.headline: Democrats seek vote on Gingrich report.

text.p: House Democrats, in a new strategy to attack Newt Gingrich, proposed Wednesday a resolution requiring the ethics committee to release a report of an investigation into tax charges against Speaker Newt Gingrich.

The resolution has no chance of approval by the House but the Democrats, led by party whip David Bonior of Michigan, said the Republicans opposing disclosure would be challenged on their vote by their election opponents.

The ethics committee received a report from special counsel James Cole last month on his investigation into whether federal law was violated in the financing with tax-deductible charitable contributions of colleges courses Gingrich taught in Georgia.
Members of a subcomittee handling the investigation have called the report a draft discussion document containing no recommendations and said it was not being released.
The House resolution introduced by Georgia Democrat Representative John Lewis said the counsel's report cost taxpayers $500,000 and the public had a right to examine it.
